answer.evidence: Nightly RX dips ~3dB from Oct19 after SC-11 re-entry. Daytime fiber loss normal. Night OTDR shows large non-reflective loss at SC-11 fiber distance (~43.3km, route 42.093km) with strong wavelength dependence (1.17dB@1310 vs 3.86dB@1550 vs 7.85dB@1625) and diurnal variation (0.82dB day vs 7.85dB night), classic macrobend from pinched slack coil. TX stable, attenuator correct.
